subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — initial draft, timeline options, and stakeholder asks
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex@clearsight.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — initial draft, timeline options, and stakeholder asks

Hi Alex (and Marta),

Thanks again for the discovery this morning — great conversation and very helpful context on your onboarding window and the integration constraints. I promised to send an initial MAP so you can see a proposed path to production and where the open decisions are.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (sheeted milestones + owners), discovery-notes-clearsight.pdf

High-level summary (please review and flag anything missing):
- Goal: POC integrated on staging + 2-week pilot with 10k inference calls/day.
- Preferred target close (hand-off to Platform/CS): choose one below.

Timeline options (pick one preferred):
1) Aggressive — Target close: 2026-08-20 (Requires immediate workstreams, legal/infosec signoff fast-track).
2) Balanced — Target close: 2026-09-10 (Recommended for most customers; cushions legal and SSO work).
3) Conservative — Target close: 2026-10-01 (Includes extra buffer for SSO/peering windows).

Milestones (overview):
- Week 0–2: Kickoff, stakeholder roster, requirements sign-off. (Owner: ClearSight)
- Week 2–5: SSO + network peering config; infra sizing for Dedicated pilot. (Owner: ClearSight + Redwood infra)
- Week 5–7: Test integration on staging; latency/cost baseline. (Owner: Redwood eng)
- Week 8: Pilot launch and operational monitoring. (Owner: ClearSight ops + Redwood CS)

Key dependencies and open risks:
- Legal/Procurement: Standard MSA + Data Processing Addendum required (legal lead: Marta).
- Security evidence: SOC2 artifact request and technical architecture sheet.
- Network: Private peering vs. public VPN decision will change timeline.
- Quota: Peak throughput estimate needed to size Dedicated pool.

Asks from your side to finalize the MAP:
- Confirm preferred target close option (Aggressive / Balanced / Conservative).
- Confirm roster: primary technical owner, security reviewer, procurement contact, and executive sponsor.
- Provide throughput estimate for pilot (QPS / daily tokens) so we can size capacity.
- Any blackout dates in August–September we should avoid.

I put owners in the attached spreadsheet; Im happy to update live with names you confirm. If you want, we can run a 30-minute MAP kickoff next week to walk through the workbook and lock owners.

Next steps from Redwood if we get confirmation this week:
- Well finalize the MAP and send a version with named owners and explicit acceptance criteria.
- Begin SOC2 evidence packaging and share an access list for engineers.
- Schedule an infra sizing sync to confirm Dedicated instance types.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0176

From: Alex Barnes <alex@clearsight.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@clearsight.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — initial draft, timeline options, and stakeholder asks

Rachel — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear workbook. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Timeline: leaning toward Balanced (2026-09-10) unless legal can move faster. I tagged the "Balanced" column in the sheet with our preferred dates.
2) Roster:
   - Technical lead: Alex Barnes (me)
   - Security reviewer: Marta Ruiz (cc'd)
   - Procurement: Karen Lin (karen.lin@clearsight.com)
   - Exec sponsor: Dr. Sheila Turner (sheila.turner@clearsight.com)
3) Throughput: pilot target is ~4k requests/day, peak ~2 QPS with 2–4k token average per request.

Two clarifying questions: 
- For SOC2 artifacts, can you give a short list of what youd like first (e.g., policies, architecture diagram, system inventory)?
- On peering: we prefer private peering but need an estimate of typical lead time so we can calendar with our network team.

Yes to a 30-min kickoff next Tues or Wed (either 10–11am PT works for me).

—Alex
Alex Barnes
Engineering Manager, Integrations | ClearSight Health
alex@clearsight.com | (206) 555-3321

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex@clearsight.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@clearsight.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — initial draft, timeline options, and stakeholder asks

Alex / Marta — great, thanks for the roster and throughput numbers. Ive updated the spreadsheet with the names you provided and set the preferred timeline to Balanced (2026-09-10).

Quick answers to your questions: 
- SOC2 artifacts well share first:
  * Security policy summary (PDF)
  * Network architecture diagram (PNG)
  * System inventory and access matrix (CSV)
  * Sample SOC2 report summary (redacted)
Well attach the first bundle to the shared Drive link by EOD Wednesday.

- Private peering lead time: approximate calendar impact is 3–5 weeks from order to established connectivity (varies by cloud region). If you need an accelerated path, we can discuss temporary VPN tunneling for the pilot.

Proposed MAP kickoff: Tuesday, 2026-06-23 at 10:30am PT — 30 minutes (Ill send a calendar invite once you confirm). Agenda: review milestones/owners, acceptance criteria for pilot, quick SOC2 ask list, and network decision gate.

Please confirm:
- MAP kickoff time (Tues 10:30am PT OK?)
- Any additional stakeholders to include on the kickoff invite (legal contact for procurement is helpful to have there).

Thanks — Ill also route the SOC2 checklist to Marta directly.

Best,
Rachel

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — initial draft, timeline options, and stakeholder asks

Thanks Rachel — Tuesday 6/23 10:30am PT works for me. Ill add Karen Lin (procurement) and our network lead, Diego Torres, to the invite. Ill also start pulling the SOC2 artifacts you listed and flag anything we cant share yet.

See you then,
Marta
